characterDescription: A minimal, compact navigation slimmed to 54px height — economical yet grounded. Generous item spacing preserves the editorial breathing room of the layout while the reduced height keeps the nav from competing with content. The left-anchored logo and restrained typographic register communicate a design intelligence that prioritizes content visibility over structural announcement.
